beebot.title: Beebot
beebot.unavailable: Beebot needs speech to text, which is not available.
beebot.howItWorks: While Beebot is on, it acts only on what starts with its name, e.g. “Beebot, add a loop after GetAllUser”; everything else is ignored. A yes / no to its own question needs no name. It never talks and shows no messages: a request that matches no command is ignored. These settings are kept in this browser.
beebot.hotkey: To speak one request into the command palette instead, press {{key}}.
beebot.languageHint: Also used for the palette microphone. “Detect” lets speech to text recognise it each time.
